package.name: ainex_camera
package.description: ROS2 Humble camera bringup for the Hiwonder AiNex head camera. Ports the ROS1 ainex_peripherals usb_cam_with_calib.launch + web_video_server stack: v4l2_camera (640x480 YUYV, /dev/video0) -> image_proc rectify -> /camera/image_rect_color, plus web_video_server on :8080 with the legacy /snapshot endpoint.
